headline: Cantonese on entity sheets, the camera timeline and Backups, and both languages fit on a phone
summary: Build 525 adds Cantonese to about 240 labels on entity sheets, to the camera timeline and to the Backups pages, and "5 minutes ago" now follows the language you choose. With English and Cantonese shown together, the four tabs at the foot of an entity sheet fit on one row at 320 px, and segmented buttons and the camera range chips no longer split a word. The Cantonese has not been read by a native reader, and state words such as On, Open and Home still stay in English in this build. The fan speed buttons and the sensor range chips still wrap in both-language mode. The build also removes a one-off helper script that should never have been committed.
summary_yue: 525 版喺實體面板、鏡頭時間軸同備份頁加入廣東話，大約二百四十個控制標籤有返廣東話，「5 分鐘前」都會跟住你揀嘅語言。英文同廣東話一齊顯示嗰陣，實體面板底部四個分頁喺 320 px 都可以一行放晒，分段掣同鏡頭範圍掣唔再將個字斬開。廣東話未經母語人士讀過，「開」、「關」、「在家」呢類狀態字暫時仍然係英文。風扇速度掣同感應器範圍掣喺雙語模式仲會換行。今版仲刪走咗一個唔應該提交嘅一次性小工具。

highlights.title: Entity sheets, the camera timeline and the Backups overview now have Cantonese
highlights.what: In Cantonese mode an entity sheet used to answer in English for almost everything except its one line of purpose. About 240 control labels now have Cantonese, covering lights, covers, locks, fans, climate, media players, alarms, vacuums, timers, weather, the details table and the related list. "5 minutes ago" follows the chosen language too. The camera timeline, the Backups overview and its dialogs, and a few lines on the Updates page follow as well. Still in English: state words such as On, Open and Home, which come from the server's single language bundle and need their own pass, and a few sentences whose blanks are filled with links or buttons. The Cantonese has not been read by a native reader, and the commit that added it says it had not yet been seen in a browser.
highlights.what_yue: 廣東話模式入面，實體面板以前除咗一行用途說明之外幾乎樣樣都答英文。而家大約二百四十個控制標籤有返廣東話，包括燈、窗簾、門鎖、風扇、冷暖氣、媒體播放器、警報、吸塵機、計時器、天氣、詳情表同相關清單。「5 分鐘前」都會跟住語言模式。鏡頭時間軸、備份總覽同佢啲對話框，以及更新頁嘅幾行字，都跟埋。仲係英文嘅有：開、關、在家呢類狀態字，因為佢哋嚟自伺服器嘅單一語言包，要另外處理；另外有幾句要填連結或者掣嘅句子。廣東話未經母語人士讀過，而加入嗰個 commit 亦話未喺瀏覽器睇過。
highlights.why: Someone who picks Cantonese expects the whole sheet to answer in Cantonese, not only the line at the top.
try: Press English, 廣東話 or Both above the pretend sheet and read the labels change.
Press a tab at the foot of the sheet. Its name, and the words under it, follow the chosen language.
Notice that On and Off stay in English. That is how this build still is.

highlights.title: Both languages fit on a phone, and the Backups pages get Cantonese
highlights.what: With English and Cantonese shown together, the four tabs at the foot of an entity sheet wrapped onto two rows and took a third of the screen at 320 px. Each tab now stacks the English with the Cantonese smaller beneath it, on one row, with 44 px targets and a 61 px bar in every language mode. Segmented buttons no longer split a word in half, the camera timeline's range chips read 1 h, 6 h and 24 h on one row, and related list rows reach 44 px. The Backups pages get their Cantonese too: the page title, "Set up backups", "Back up now", "My backups", the backup types, and the Filters and More labels shared by every list page. Still wrapping in both-language mode are the fan speed buttons and the sensor range chips. The layout was checked in a browser at 390 and 320 px.
highlights.what_yue: 英文同廣東話一齊顯示嗰陣，實體面板底部四個分頁會爆成兩行，喺 320 px 霸咗成個螢幕三分一。而家每個分頁上面英文、下面細字廣東話，一行過，每個 44 px，成條底欄喺邊個語言模式都係 61 px。分段掣唔再將一個字斬開兩半，鏡頭時間軸嘅範圍掣一行寫晒 1 h、6 h、24 h，相關清單每行夠 44 px。備份頁都有返廣東話：頁面標題、「設定備份」、「立即備份」、「我嘅備份」、備份類型，仲有每個清單頁共用嘅「篩選」同「更多」。雙語模式仲會換行嘅有風扇速度掣同感應器範圍掣。版面喺瀏覽器 390 同 320 px 睇過。
highlights.why: A tab bar that wraps onto a second row, or a word cut in half, makes the screen harder to use on a small phone in both languages.
try: Press Both, then press each of the four tabs and see that they stay on one row.
Press 1 h, 6 h and 24 h and watch the bar and the words under it change.
Press English and see the same row and the same places, with the Cantonese removed.
